220078.description:
Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children’s clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche’s stepmom, she’s determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl’s cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family?

(Source: Tapas)

220106.description:
As a child, Kotarou was humiliated by a group of bullies, Akira, a wrestling prodigy, Kanae, a basketball prodigy, and Sigure, a gamer prodigy, who would beat him at anything they tried. Now in high school, Kotarou is reunited with those three bullies, and he swears he will get back at them this time…!? It's a romantic comedy about taking revenge on bullies!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220167.description:
Detectives who use force to solve violent crimes—commonly known as “Butei.” Kinji Toyama and Aria H. Kanzaki have solved cases all over the world.

Upon their return to Japan, the two were met with a runaway incident involving drones and robots on Gakuen Island.

To solve the case, they’re joined by Shirayuki, Riko, and Reki from Baskerville, as well as Kinji’s maid Lisa, Aria’s younger sister—the master detective Minuet—and even Nemo, who was once their formidable foe!

Packed with gunfights and romantic intrigue, the new story of the Butei begins now!

(Source: Official Website, translated)
